subset: vlalora BridgeData V2 RLDS subset, seed 42, 60 train shards + 12 val shards, 7.756 GiB
rule: Official RLDS split is preserved. train.csv = official train trajectories labeled on_surface or in_container. test.csv = official val trajectories with the same labels. A trajectory is never divided across the two files. Category other is excluded, matching scripts/bridge_filters.py course_task_filter_v2.
